definitions.explanation: Describes someone with an outgoing, bright, and energetic personality. Suggests a naturally positive disposition and engaging manner.

examples.japanese: {快活|かいかつ}な{笑顔|えがお}
{彼女|かのじょ}は{快活|かいかつ}で{誰|だれ}からも{好|す}かれる。
examples.english: She is cheerful and liked by everyone.

examples.japanese: {快活|かいかつ}な{性格|せいかく}の{彼|かれ}は、{職場|しょくば}のムードメーカーだ。
examples.english: With his vivacious personality, he is the mood maker of the workplace.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective. Uses な before nouns: {快活|かいかつ}な{性格|せいかく}.

NUANCE: {快活|かいかつ} describes a bright, outgoing personality with natural energy and positivity. It's a straightforward compliment suggesting someone who is fun to be around.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {快活|かいかつ}な{笑顔|えがお} (cheerful smile)
- {快活|かいかつ}な{性格|せいかく} (lively personality)
- {快活|かいかつ}な{人|ひと} (cheerful person)
- {快活|かいかつ}に{話|はな}す (to speak vivaciously)

RELATED WORDS:
- {明|あか}るい (bright, cheerful - more common)
- {陽気|ようき} (cheerful, jovial)
- {溌剌|はつらつ} (lively, vigorous)
- {活発|かっぱつ} (active, lively)
